summary: Scope cited RFI/Submittal date roles to the same exact workflow identity.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy and adaptability
The user requested project questions answered only from existing files
Offline reproductions proved both a cross-RFI date false acceptance and a distinct-RFI date false ambiguity
approval_evidence: The persistent RFI, Submittal and Email objective authorizes this deterministic answer-accuracy improvement.
known_limitations: A source statement containing several workflow identities is not semantically distributed among them; each dated statement must identify one item or use a unique locator.
Email dates without an explicit RFI/Submittal identity retain citation-local date-role rules rather than inferred thread identity.
Multiple dates for one normalized identity and role remain ambiguous; no event ordering or authority is inferred.
The guard does not prove that every relevant project document was uploaded or parsed.
